native_rules: A null MoveManager fails before state writes. Otherwise State3, LeftMoves, MadeMoves and WonAnyLevel are captured before the admin early return. Admin wins do not require account/reward snapshots.

Non-admin wins resolve the actual inventory owner, call the Coin snapshot virtual Init and then AddExtra for the coin goal. Milestone packages occur at positive multiples of1000 outside story/table/league; the normal/table/story flag combinations retain original ordering.

Story non-water wins replace LeftMoves with Seconds before the table-game branch; table wins otherwise set LeftMoves0. Those branches reset extraCoins. Ordinary wins preserve the original extraCoins value.

League adds the difficulty-weighted crown; ordinary non-story/non-table wins add one star. The original23 reward dispatch entries retain event eligibility and SkyRace short-circuit ordering, Archery/WorldCup multipliers and TeamTreasure wheel/streak side effects.
SuperBooster eligibility retains repeated tutorial/unlock queries and the persistent-level fallback for story. Feature/tutorial gates control snapshot addition and win counting.

SuperDuke win eligibility is league or Number>=402: native literal0x192. The ARM64 differential caught an initial410 conversion mistake; the actual runtime threshold was corrected and401/402/403 boundaries are included.
MagicDuke compares the snapshot Before value with the owner maximum, optionally adds one, and always forwards snapshot After when the feature is ready.

Typed account/event/feature/cloche inputs remain explicit fixtures. The existing RoyalPass/Pinata snapshot classes execute real locked-event validity gates; unexpected locked-event queries and resource/feature progression throw.
